def csize(fr):
    s=fr.segmentation; tot=0

seg=current_frame.segmentation
# grid tile colors
from collections import Counter
gc=Counter()
for n in seg['nodes']:

        gc[n['color']]+=1
print('grid tile colors:',dict(gc))
for n in seg['nodes']:

        r0=min(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c0=min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
